key_idea: Look for the basket whose toys are not on the floor.
steps: Every toy on the floor comes from one basket. Check each basket's toys against the floor.
The toys from baskets A, C, D and E are all on the floor.
The heart, the pentagon and the cross from basket B are not on the floor. The only diamond on the floor is pink, like the one in basket D, not purple like the one in B.
So basket B did not fall.

choice_feedback.A: The circle, square, triangle and star from basket A are all on the floor.
choice_feedback.C: The oval, rectangle, hexagon and arrow from basket C are all on the floor.
choice_feedback.D: The half circle, ring, trapezoid and pink diamond from basket D are all on the floor.
choice_feedback.E: The T, the L, the slanted box and the two rings from basket E are all on the floor.
